verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Kimi API is OpenAI- and Anthropic-protocol compatible and publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec plus an Admin API spec. However, no item documents an official Kimi or Moonshot SDK package. Protocol compatibility with third-party SDKs and a downloadable OpenAPI document are adjacent building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
